framings.label: Historic first milestone
framings.description: Headlines present the tower catch as an unprecedented, history-making achievement, often with vivid imagery such as giant mechanical arms snatching the ship from the sky.

framings.label: Live event and anticipation
framings.description: Posts treat the flight as an unfolding event, with livestreams, live updates and previews of the planned double-catch attempt.

framings.label: Setback followed by recovery
framings.description: Coverage stresses that the booster catch was aborted or missed, then presents the ship catch as the success that followed.

framings.label: Reusability and lunar ambitions
framings.description: Some pieces place the catch in the context of reusable rockets and the company's moon and deep-space goals, treating the flight as a test of those plans.

framings.label: Company, Musk and market angle
framings.description: A few items frame the catch through its meaning for Elon Musk, the company's victory, or stock and investment implications.
